title: Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards Terms of Quotation for Volume Pricing
content:
Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards members may request volume pricing quotes for large pre-tax orders, priced at a discount up to a ceiling set by order size, and accepted and purchased within set periods.

## Terms

**T1. Request.** An active member may request a volume pricing quote, recorded as a quote on the membership, for a pre-tax order of at least the tier's smallest quote order, with no more than the tier's largest number of lines per quote and no item from the departments never volume priced. The member's open quotes, those in status requested or priced, may not exceed the tier's largest number of open quotes.

**T2. Discount ceiling and pricing time.** The quoted discount may not exceed the largest discount of the highest step of the tier's volume discount ladder whose order figure the quote total reaches, the quote total being the pre-tax total of the quoted lines at shelf price. The quote is priced within the tier's pricing time, in hours.

**T3. Acceptance, revision and purchase.** A priced quote may be accepted within the tier's acceptance period, in days, of pricing, and revised at most the tier's revision limit; once accepted it must be purchased within the tier's purchase period, in days, after which it expires.

**T4. Purchases under a quote.** A purchase priced under a quote carries the volume-quote pricing basis and the quote applied. Quote pricing is never combined with the paint discount where the tier's paint discount does not apply to quote-priced paint, and on a Ridgeline Pro Credit commercial account it excludes the invoice from the prompt-payment discount.

## Illustrations (hypothetical ladder and figures)

Hypothetical ladder: from USD 2000.00 a discount of up to 3 percent; from USD 8000.00, up to 6 percent.

| Quote total | Highest step reached | Largest discount that may be quoted |
|---|---|---|
| USD 1999.99 | none; below the smallest order | no quote may be requested where USD 2000.00 is the smallest quote order |
| USD 7999.99 | first | 3 percent |
| USD 8000.00 | second | 6 percent |
| USD 40000.00 | second | 6 percent |

**Open quotes (hypothetical limit of 3).** A member with three quotes in status requested or priced already stands at the limit; a further request would take the open quotes above 3 and may not be made. Quotes in status accepted, purchased, expired or declined are not open quotes and do not count.

**Request conditions.** A request meets T1 when the membership is active, the pre-tax order reaches the smallest quote order, the lines do not exceed the line limit, no item comes from appliances, gift cards or power tools, and the open quotes stay within their limit.
